On an island every inhabitant is either a truth-teller (whose every statement is true) or a liar (whose every statement is false). Three inhabitants — Ravi, Sunil and Tara — each make one statement.

- Ravi says: "At least one of the other two is a truth-teller"
- Sunil says: "Exactly one of the three of us is a liar"
- Tara says: "Sunil is a liar"
